summary.text: Michael C. Walsh is the Republican nominee for Attorney General of Massachusetts. A Lynnfield native and general-practice attorney with about 15 years of practice, he is litigating cases against the current Attorney General's office and is campaigning on enforcing a legislative audit law, local control of zoning and lower utility bills.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Lynnfield; earned his bachelor's degree at 17 and his law degree at 21 at Suffolk University, which his campaign calls the youngest graduate in school history.
General-practice litigator whose work includes public employment and labor law, criminal defense, military law, administrative procedure, land use and zoning.
